editorial:
Imagine a world where the richest people on earth are just as messy and stressed as you are. You get to follow a group of billionaire buddies who gather for a fancy getaway while a massive global crisis is unfolding right outside their doors. Instead of actually helping, they spend most of their time arguing over small things and trying to protect their own money. It feels like a giant party where everyone is secretly hating each other, and the vibe is a perfect mix of awkward laughs and serious drama. You will find yourself laughing at how out of touch these people are while wondering how they actually run the world.

The acting is the best part here because the cast makes these arrogant characters feel surprisingly human. The pacing is quick, and the dialogue is sharp, though some of the political talk might feel a bit heavy at times. If you love seeing rich people lose their cool, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart when the group realizes their own greed caused the crisis they were hiding from. In the final scenes, the friends turn on each other to save their own skins. The big twist is that the youngest billionaire was leaking their secrets to the press the whole time. He ends up being the only one who keeps his wealth, while the others lose everything and face legal trouble as the credits roll.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves sharp comedies about wealth and power.
